optimization_applied.name: portfolio_engine._build_context trailing-window fast path
optimization_applied.description: Avoid O(B) per-symbol per-decision scan of full history (`[b for b in bars if b.timestamp <= ts]`) when _history lists are already timestamp-sorted and tail <= decision timestamp (common in backtest). Take `bars[-trim:]` slice directly (O(trim)) vs scanning entire history (O(B) ~1500). Fallback to reversed scan for out-of-order/future-bar rare case. Preserves benchmark_key exempt semantics (SPY/BTC not trimmed).
optimization_applied.hot_path: equity v2 backtest 2019-2021 and crypto v2 full (bench_backtest.py)
optimization_applied.risk: Low — relies on _history sorted invariant (ingestion in global timestamp order). Fallback handles unsorted/future bars without changing observable history keys, last bar, or trimmed window.
